title: Jeertinaango Toowngo Hade Koɗo Marsi
intro: Naatde e falnde ɗo laamɗo mawɗo e konu mawngu ina ɓadii, ƴeewto-ɗaa yahoowo tokooso ina rokka jeertinaango hisnoowo renndo ngoo fof. No renndo hulɓiniingo ngoo yettorii hoɗorde nii, kulhuli ɗii ina njaha. Rewtu e nate ngam anndude limoore nde yejjittaake caggal ndeen jeertinaango.
clues: Miɗo jeyaa e tagooje tokoose jokkondirɗe e laamu laamɗo.
Renndo am ina hoɗi e hoɗorɗe nder falnde, ɗo gooto e men waawi noddude woɗɓe ɓee.
En njiyii kulhuli ummoraade e oon laamɗo e konuuli yahduɗi e laamɗo oo.
Ko miin noddata renndo am ngam naatde e hoɗorde mum en, jeertina en woto en njuumtu tawa en nganndaa.
Laamɗo oo ko Sileymaani, leñol am ina jeyaa e tagooje baɗaaɗe e les yamiroore makko.
Ko miin woni mboros oon falnde; caggal jeertinaango am, min naati e hoɗorde amen, min ndogi e ɓuuɓri ndi so wonaano ɗuum, min nanngata min min nganndaa.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Ɗaɓɓaande jokkere enɗam ummoraade e liɗɗi

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Renndo ngoo hisnaama caggal nde ƴetti hoɗorde
Renndo ngo halkaama, ƴettataa ɗo suuɗii
Renndo ngoo daɗii sabu konu nguu rewtii caggal
Renndo ngoo yoɓaama e jogaade doole e dow colli ɗii
Renndo ngoo nanngaa to galle laamorɗo
outcome.answer: Renndo ngoo hisnaama caggal nde ƴetti hoɗorde

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
